solution: Solution: First halide bond will cleave to form halide and benzene and then halide will react with sodium. As a result, benzene and sodium bromide is formed. In    second step, there will be a bond cleavage of $\mathrm{CH}_3-\mathrm{Br}$ to form $\mathrm{CH}_3^{\bullet}+\mathrm{NaBr}$ . Free radical $\mathrm{CH}_3^{\bullet}$ react with benzene to form toluene. © examsnet.com

question: The total number of $\mathrm{S_N}2$ (Nucleophilic substitution bimolecular) reactions involved in the following reaction sequence is _______

answer_provenance.method: single green option label (RGB 0,128,0); four option labels required

solution: Solution: Total number of $\mathrm{S_N}2$ reactions involved in the reaction is three. In first $\mathrm{S_N}2$ reaction methoxy group is replaced by OH group (i.e. $\mathrm{CH}_3$ group replace by $\mathrm{H}^{+}$ of HI) . In second $\mathrm{S_N}$ 2 reaction another methoxy group get replaced by $\mathrm{OH}$ . In third $\mathrm{S_N}2$ reaction $\mathrm{OH}$ get replaced by iodide group. © examsnet.com
